items.title: IT Operations, Monitoring and Service Management
items.summary: Covers auditing IT operations, monitoring, job scheduling and service management controls.
objectives: Assess monitoring and incident handling evidence

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Covers auditing IT operations, monitoring, job scheduling and service management controls. This lesson focuses on practical understanding, decision-making and evidence-based GRC practice.
bullets: Assess monitoring and incident handling evidence

sections.heading: Key concepts
sections.body: Core concepts for it operations, monitoring and service management are explained in plain language, with emphasis on roles, controls, risks and expected outcomes in an enterprise context.

sections.heading: Application
sections.body: Learners should be able to apply the concepts to realistic scenarios, justify decisions, and recognise common gaps or weaknesses.

examples.title: Applying IT Operations, Monitoring and Service Management
examples.context: A team must address it operations, monitoring and service management in a business scenario with limited time and resources.
examples.outcome: A risk-informed, documented decision with clear ownership and follow-up actions.

practicalExercise.title: Exercise: IT Operations, Monitoring and Service Management
practicalExercise.brief: Apply the lesson to a fictional organisation facing challenges related to it operations, monitoring and service management.
practicalExercise.deliverable: A short action plan with rationale.
